description: The plot illustrates the relationship between model size and average performance metrics, including precision, recall, and F1-score. The x-axis represents model size on a logarithmic scale, ranging from 70 million to 7.0 billion, with tick labels at 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis represents average performance as a percentage, with a linear scale from 0 to 80, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The plot displays three lines: precision (red, triangle marker, solid line), recall (blue, triangle marker, solid line), and F1-score (purple, triangle marker, solid line). The precision line starts at approximately 78% for a 70 million model size and decreases to around 72% at 7.0 billion, with a slight decline across the x-axis. The recall line begins at around 13% for a 70 million model size and increases to approximately 50% at 7.0 billion, showing a steady upward trend. The F1-score line starts at around 18% for a 70 million model size and rises to about 62% at 7.0 billion, also displaying a steady increase across the x-axis.
